svg.title: Freehand scales and lace
svg.text: Trace the gray models first, then fill the empty boxes on your own. Lesson 08.3.
Must measure 10 cm. If not, print at 100% ("Actual size").
Scales: bottom row first, each U starts in a gap of the row below
your own: one row per dotted line
Lace: scallops, loops, dots, then a fine net with dot flowers
your own lace along the dotted curve
